title: fix(cloud-connection)!: install-local judges a ledger entry in the CLI's lifted shape through the install door's flatten, at boot and on the sample-data doors
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XQQCpJU17CHdHiXkbKYBsc8)_

Fixes #28604

Clause-②: no (narrowing) — at `kernel:ready` the install-local rehydrate no longer loads, and `POST /api/v1/marketplace/install-local/:manifestId/reseed-sample-data` and `/purge-sample-data` answer 422 `OS_PROTOCOL_INCOMPATIBLE` for, a ledger entry an install wrote before #28535 in the body `os package install FILE` sends (`id` and `version` lifted beside a nested `manifest`) whose nested `engines.protocol` excludes this runtime. That entry loaded, and those doors acted on it, before. A flat entry with the same range was already refused the same way. Nothing is widened.
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — the pages already state the behaviour this restores: `skills/objectstack-platform/SKILL.md` ("The runtime checks it before it loads anything and refuses an out-of-range app at the boundary"). No page described a ledgered CLI install as an exception.

**BREAKING** boot-load and accept-set narrowing for already-ledgered install-local entries (`@objectstack/cloud-connection`): the `kernel:ready` rehydrate and the two sample-data doors, reached by a deployment where `os package install ./dist/objectstack.json` ran before PR #28603.

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：启动时重新加载已安装应用（`kernel:ready` rehydrate）、以及「重置/清除示例数据」两个接口，读台账条目时先经安装接口已有的同一个展平函数（`flattenPackageBody`）再做协议握手；rehydrate 的依赖排序也读展平后的条目。
- **为什么改**：卡 #28604。PR #28603 之前，`os package install` 发来的产物（`id`/`version` 提到顶层、`engines` 嵌在 `manifest` 下）原样写进台账。启动时只看顶层 `engines`，读不到嵌套的范围，于是不兼容协议的包每次启动都照常加载，没有任何报错。
- **风险与回滚**：只影响「PR #28603 之前用 CLI 装的、且协议范围不兼容」的台账条目：现在与平铺条目同样处理（不加载、一条 error 日志、列表标 `notLoaded`、两个示例数据接口答 422，DELETE 与兼容版本重装照常）。兼容的条目照旧加载，注册的内容与台账一字不差。回滚即 revert。
- **先看**：`packages/cloud-connection/src/marketplace-install-local-plugin.ts`（rehydrate 握手 ≈:1109、`inDependencyOrder`、`refuseProtocolIncompatibleEntry`、`flattenPackageBody` 的空值守卫）；`marketplace-install-local-protocol-handshake.test.ts` 新 `[#28604]` 用例组；`.changeset/28604-install-local-rehydrate-lifted-entry.md`。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/cloud-connection exec vitest run src/marketplace-install-local-protocol-handshake.test.ts src/marketplace-install-local-sample-data-not-loaded.test.ts src/marketplace-install-local-rehydrate-order.test.ts` → 37/37 通过。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地（收窄需先过合约评审）。

## What changes

**The one flatten, read at three more places** (`packages/cloud-connection/src/marketplace-install-local-plugin.ts`). An install before PR #28603 ledgered the CLI's body as it arrived: `{ id, version, manifest: { …, engines, dependencies }, objects, data, … }`. Every reader that decides by a manifest key read it at the top, so the nested keys were invisible. Each now reads the entry through `flattenPackageBody`, the function the install door already uses (no second flatten, no second handshake):

- the `kernel:ready` rehydrate's `checkProtocolCompat(flattenPackageBody(entry.manifest))`, so an excluded nested range is not loaded, is recorded in `refusedAtRehydrate` (the listing's `notLoaded` marker) and gets the one error line, exactly as a flat entry;
- `refuseProtocolIncompatibleEntry`, the reseed/purge doors' handshake, so both answer the install route's 422 for it before any side effect;
- `inDependencyOrder`, so a lifted entry is ordered by the `dependencies` its nested manifest declares (ADR-0141 D5). At boot, a flat entry's dependencies are used for this ordering only (the rehydrate runs no dependency check: `checkDeclaredDependencies` is called only at the install door), so ordering is the parity a lifted entry is owed.

`flattenPackageBody` gains a `!isPlainObject(body)` guard so it is total over a ledger value, which `LocalManifestSource` does not shape-check. Measured: a `null`, a string and a number `manifest` produce byte-identical rehydrate logs, registrations and door answers on base and head (probe in the evidence folder below).

**What stays as today.** A compatible lifted entry registers, converts, binds and seeds the body exactly as ledgered: only the judging and the ordering read the flattened view. The install door and its #28603 flatten are untouched.

## Why

ADR-0087 D1 puts the handshake "before loading a package's metadata", and a rehydrate is a load (#21762). The triage (`6557784727`) graded the reach p3: one closed population, the entries a CLI install wrote before PR #28603 (`7449e479`), since new installs are refused at the door.

## Tests

- `marketplace-install-local-protocol-handshake.test.ts`, new group `[#28604] kernel:ready rehydrate of an entry ledgered in the CLI's lifted shape`: the lifted `^17` entry is not registered, nothing is synced, and its error lines equal a flat `^17` entry's on a fresh ledger, byte for byte; the GET listing marks it `notLoaded { code: OS_PROTOCOL_INCOMPATIBLE, requiredRange: ^17 }`; lit control: a lifted `^18` entry rehydrates with no error and registers the body deep-equal to the ledgered one.
- `marketplace-install-local-sample-data-not-loaded.test.ts`, new group: precondition (lifted refused not loaded, lifted loadable loaded); reseed and purge on the lifted refused entry answer 422, leave i18n, seed-datasets, the engine and the ledger unchanged, and their payloads equal the flat entry's byte for byte; lit control: both doors answer 200 on the lifted loadable entry.
- `marketplace-install-local-rehydrate-order.test.ts`: a lifted module entry listed ahead of its parent registers after it.

**Red on base** (plugin source swapped to `origin/main` `0b6a52e8`; on disk: flatten-at-judge count 0, base judge count 2; restored with `git checkout HEAD --`, `git diff HEAD` empty, blob hash equal to HEAD): 5 failed / 32 passed of 37, exactly the five lifted-shape cases above that judge or order; both lit controls pass on both trees. **Green** on head: 37/37.

**Ablation**, one leg per site, through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor 1 → 0 on disk, restored to the HEAD blob, `git diff HEAD` empty after each). The tests import the plugin by relative path (source), so there is no dist leg.

| Leg | Mutation | Red |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | rehydrate judges `entry.manifest` | 3: the two boot cases + the sample-data precondition |
| 2 | door judges `entry.manifest` | 1: reseed/purge byte parity |
| 3 | order reads `entry.manifest` | 1: the lifted dependency order |

## Acceptance notes

- **Pre-existing, not changed:** a ledger file whose `manifest` is `null` throws `Cannot read properties of null (reading 'engines')` from `checkProtocolCompat`, at the rehydrate (logged as "rehydrate failed") and out of the reseed/purge handlers. Identical on base and head. No door or producer writes such an entry, so it is noted here and not filed.
- Overlap: re-read the 17 open PRs before `pr_create`; none touches the plugin file or the three test files.

## Verification

All on head `365d3ac3` (the only commit; the base is `origin/main` `0b6a52e8`).

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cloud-connection test`: 65 files / 796 tests passed. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cloud-connection typecheck`: exit 0 (under the verify lock, `VERDICT command-exit 0`).
- The three touched files alone: 37/37.
- **Full dogfood battery** (owed by the `(narrowing)` arm), closure built then `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood test` under the lock: `VERDICT command-exit 0` (held 2009s) · Test Files 369 passed, 3 skipped (372) · Tests 2981 passed, 28 skipped (3009) · no failures.
- **Derived gates:** `dispatch-gates --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 60 families; all 60 exit 0, exit codes captured before any pipe. `--ran`: "60 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 60 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero — all 60 recorded an exit code and none of them is 3)". Two first runs were not measurements and were re-run to exit 0: `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` exited 3 on the shallow clone until its pinned fixture commit was fetched, and `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exited 3 until a full `packages/**` build. Record: project file `pm-orders/server/evidence/28604/gates-ran-365d3ac3.txt`.
- CI families (lint, Test Core shards and the rest) are read from this PR's check-runs, not re-run locally.
- Non-object ledger probe (base vs head byte-identical): `pm-orders/server/evidence/28604/non-object-ledger-probe.txt`.
